title: Camping Trip Planner Printable, Tent Camping Checklist, Car Camping Packing List, Camp Meal Planner, Campsite Log, Family Camping PDF
description:
Plan a camping trip at a campground without the scramble. This 24-page planner walks you through choosing and booking a site, then gives you the checklists and fill-in pages for the camp kitchen, the meals, the car and the whole family.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Choosing a campground: national parks, national forests, state and provincial parks, private campgrounds
- Booking your site: recreation.gov, Parks Canada, state and provincial sites, first-come sites
- Picking a good site: flat ground, shade, wind, water and toilets, dead trees overhead
- Trip overview and a weather and backup plan
- Checklists: tent and sleep, camp kitchen, clothing per person (4 columns), kids and family add-on
- Packing the car: what goes in last so it comes out first
- 3-day meal planner, easy camp meal ideas and a grocery list
- Cooler packing and food safety
- Food storage and wildlife, campfire and stove safety, Leave No Trace at the campsite
- Arrive and set up, pack up and leave checklists
- Rainy-day ideas and campsite bingo
- Campsite log for 8 campsites

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Booking windows, fire restrictions and food storage rules differ by park and forest, so check the campground's official page before you go. Never use a fuel stove or heater inside a tent. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
